text: Hello, everyone. Ladies and gentlemen,
the whole world is concerned about the
pneumonic plague situation in Russia.
The U.S. has stepped in, the U.N. has
stepped in, and many major newspapers
like Forbes, CNN, and the Financial
Times have all stepped in. The biggest
question currently being raised by U.S.
senators is whether this variant has
been modified. Is it a biological
weapon or not? Furthermore, the World
Health Organization has even confirmed
that pneumonic plague is a
super-spreading form. It is unknown to
what extent Russia has been able to
contain it. The entire world now knows
that an employee at a pneumonic plague
laboratory has passed away. She was
only 28 or 29 years old. Because of
that, hundreds of people—somewhere
around 200—are currently being
quarantined in the Siberia region.
However, the Irkutsk region has
airports that fly to many different
areas all over the world. From this
Russian region of Irkutsk, you can fly
to Beijing, Bangkok, Moscow, Harbin,
Chita, Saint Petersburg, Guangzhou,
Phuket in Thailand, Shanghai, and many
other places. This means that if by any
chance an F0 patient has traveled
outside, it would be extremely
difficult to trace. Currently, the U.S.
is demanding that Russia answer whether
the sample inside that pneumonic plague
laboratory was a variant sample or not.
The language used in reports from
newspapers like the Financial Times,
Sky News, CNN, or Forbes magazine all
consists of technical terminology.
Therefore, we need to be very precise.
For example, these are the words of
Senator Rand Paul. He is a U.S. senator
who has questioned Mr. Fauci in many
sessions. Therefore, he challenged
Russia, questioning them as follows. If
it is a normal plague, it can be
treated, but if it is a variant, if it
has been weaponized, it will be
drug-resistant, meaning it is
untreatable. So, he recently shared an
article from The Washington Post
stating that several current and former
U.S. officials are hoping to find out
whether Russia has altered any disease
samples inside the lab. This is called
gain of function. This is the term used
extensively with COVID-19, known as "
tăng cường chức năng." Normally,
when researchers want to study
treatments for a specific epidemic,
they often conduct what is called
gain-of-function research. It is
understood here as enhancing the
function of disease resistance. So,
when performing such gain-of-function
research, they manipulate the pathogen
samples, potentially changing them from
the original, which also means they
could become resistant to current
antibiotics. In particular, we have a
report from Insider Paper citing an
article from the Russian TASS news
agency, stating that among those who
had contact with the patient, they
discovered two people positive for
COVID and two others infected with what
is called Z-fever. Here, we understand
it as Z-fever. They clearly stated the
two COVID cases already. And those two
cases are currently being translated as
malaria. According to the Russian
report, there are currently nearly 200
people in the area surrounding the lab
who were in contact with the patient
and are being quarantined. Out of those
200 people, they detected two cases of
COVID and two cases of malaria.
Meanwhile, the British news outlet Sky
News says there are thousands of people
currently being quarantined, but Dan
has checked and it is only a few
hundred. 200 people are quarantined,
yet they reported 1,000, which is
incorrect. In particular, the World
Health Organization (WHO) stated that
this pneumonic plague is especially
contentious, meaning especially
contagious. CNN also invited the expert
Dr. Asis. He said that something is
happening. He suspects that Russia is
downplaying the situation, meaning they
are covering up some information and
not disclosing it to the outside world.
On the U.S. side, President Trump has
already received the report. Secretary
of State Marco Rubio has also received
the report. To summarize, Rany thinks
we should hear from the State
Department and Mr. Marco Rubio, as that
would be the most accurate. As for the
media outlets just mentioned, perhaps
they did not receive as full a report
as Mr. Rubio did. Mr. Rubio said that
this has not yet reached the level
where we need to be warned or alarmed.
But it is an issue that we must focus
on and that we need to keep an eye on.
This means we need to monitor it
closely and focus our attention on that
issue. If there is any sudden change,
it must be handled immediately. As for
now, it has not reached the point of a
nationwide alert for the entire United
States. Ladies and gentlemen, all these
developments are taking place while
Russia is still pursuing the war in
Ukraine. Typically, when difficulties
arrive, it is very likely that they
will pile up on top of one another like
this. Let us return to the battlefield
to see what the Russians are currently
doing. There is some information coming
from inside Russia. The Russian people
have spoken out, saying that Mr. Putin
has actually begun a general
mobilization, and many Russian widows
are crying out. President Putin is
doing three things. The first is a
silent general mobilization. He does
not publicly state it, but the Russian
people all know, and they are screaming
. The second development is that
President Putin is increasing bombings
on infrastructure, starting to bomb
bridges and roads. This has not
happened in the past four years, but
now Mr. Putin is escalating in that
direction. And the third is nuclear
threats against Europe and against NATO
. Will President Putin repeat the
mistakes of Hitler in the past? Let us
look at each development one by one.
First, regarding the general
mobilization. These are the words of a
Russian girl who is only 21 years old
but has already lost two husbands, and
she is truly screaming at President
Putin's mobilization order. Her exact
words are as follows: "End this war. We
are too tired of losing our husbands.
We are too tired of losing everyone. Do
you understand? You haven't lost
anything at all. But we are the ones
having to bear the losses." We are
losing our dearest loved ones. You are
now carrying out a new mobilization.
You are driving up our prices. We are
losing our husbands and our children.
We cannot take it anymore. Do you
understand? We never wanted this war.
Do you understand? Just split that
Crimean peninsula in half then.
Honestly, I am completely fed up with
this. I am ready to say it all straight
out. I have two small children. I am so
tired. I am afraid the kids will get
hit by shelling now. I want everyone to
spread this video message everywhere,
to the whole world. Because my nerves
are completely shattered. Now I am
about to marry my third husband. We
will register our marriage in a few
days. I have already lost two husbands.
I did not take a single cent of
compensation from them. I gave it all
to relatives, I didn't even keep a
share for my own children. Do you
understand? I am an orphan myself. I
grew up in an orphanage. They didn't
even provide an apartment for me. I am
only 21 this year and I already have
two children. I am currently living in
a rented house. A damn rental, no water
, no sewage system, not even decent
windows. Do you see that I have to keep
everything covered with curtains? Where
is Russia now? Even though the Russian
people cry out and plead, President
Putin has chosen to escalate. And an
article in The Telegraph points out
that Mr. Putin is making the same
mistake Hitler did years ago. Years ago
, Hitler bombed London relentlessly,
hoping to crush the fighting spirit of
the British people. But in the end, it
was Hitler who was defeated. This is
the article from The Telegraph. It is
astounding that Vladimir Putin is
repeating Hitler's mistake of thinking
he can defeat a brave people with
constant aerial attacks. With more than
40,000 civilians killed during Hitler's
8-month Blitz campaign. The death toll
and scale of destruction were too great
to honor all the rescuers, paramedics,
bomb disposal units, and firefighters.
Final statistics show over 1 million
homes were destroyed or damaged, half
of which were in the capital, London.
Now, Putin is repeating that very same
mistake, targeting Ukraine's capital,
Kyiv. The targets remain the same:
churches, libraries, shops, ports,
restaurants, offices, and even
memorials. Above all, the spirit of the
people. For London, 57 consecutive
nights of bombing since September 7,
1940, did not break the population. By
1942, under the command of Air Chief
Marshal Sir Arthur Harris, the bombing
of German cities became the new policy
of the RAF Bomber Command. And quoting
the Old Testament at the time, General
Harris declared that they had sown the
wind and now they would reap the
whirlwind. British policy was coldly
described as destroying homes to leave
people without shelter. It originated
from a memo drafted by Churchill's
chief scientific advisor. This was
retaliation because Hitler had done it
first. For every ton of bombs Germany
dropped on London, 20 to 40 houses were
destroyed, leaving 100 to 200 people
homeless. However, bombing never
settles a war. Be it Germany or Britain
, it is the same. Yet Putin is
repeating it in exactly the same way.
Russia’s initial, relatively crude
bombardments of Kyiv and elsewhere in
2022 have evolved into attacks using
far more modern and lethal weapons.
Besides ballistic missiles like the
Iskander-M, the hallmark weapons of
this new Russian blitz campaign—
leading to the attack on the National
Academy of Sciences of Ukraine—are
the latest generation of jet-powered
attack UAVs, Geran-4 and Geran-5, which
can reach speeds of nearly 500 km/h.
They are three times faster than
previous propeller-driven models. But
just as the British spirit was not
broken during the air raids, citizens
in German cities did not turn against
their Nazi rulers amidst the Allied
bombings. There is no sign that the
Ukrainian people are yielding. In Kyiv,
Lviv, Odessa, and Kharkiv, ordinary
Ukrainian citizens remain resilient and
courageous. Although air raid warnings
are now sent via mobile phones, sirens
still constantly wail with the sounds
of exploding incoming drones and
missiles, along with air defense
interceptors. The sounds of war have
become a nearly constant presence in
daily life across the territory of
Ukraine. These air raids can occur ten
times every day. The capital, Kyiv,
alone had 76 alerts in the seven days
from August 27 to September 3; Russia's
goal is not only to cause damage but
also to disrupt lives and deprive
Ukrainians of food and sleep. However,
a survey conducted early in the
conflict in 2022 concluded that only 2%
of Ukrainians were experiencing
severely low morale, primarily among
those in the East and retirees. Despite
this, 83%of the Ukrainian population
still eat as usual, and 82%continue to
plan for the future. Defying Putin just
as previous generations defied
Hitler’s bombs, the spirit of staying
calm and carrying on is helping the
capital of Kyiv and other cities endure
the suffering they face every day. We
all know the ultimate end point of air
raid escalation is the use of nuclear
weapons. And indeed, this past weekend,
somewhere around the 3rd or 4th,
President Putin made nuclear threats.
So, does he dare to use nuclear weapons
? This time he said it was to protect
the Kaliningrad region, but will Putin
escalate to the point of using tactical
nuclear weapons, and what is he
mobilizing more troops for? Putin has
publicly declared that he will increase
the military's size to 2.4 million
personnel. So who will he recruit, and
if not from the big cities, where will
he get the people? This is an analysis
by former tycoon Mikhail Khodorkovsky.
When he noted that in the past month,
Putin has publicly declared three times
that he has no intention of attacking
Europe. The last time he repeatedly
insisted on having no such intention of
attacking was with Ukraine. Is this
comparison accurate? Do we need to
prepare for a new war? Indeed, Putin
has repeatedly dismissed speculations
about his plans to attack Europe. This
has happened. I have specifically noted
the dates: June 4th, and September 11th
, 18th, and 25th, 2026. It is indeed
with quite high frequency. In parallel
with all of that, the Russian Foreign
Ministry sent a diplomatic note to NATO
declaring readiness to use nuclear
weapons, specifically tactical nuclear
weapons, to defend Kaliningrad. This is
a move in response to perfectly
understandable military exercises held
to protect the Suwalki corridor, the
area connecting the Baltic states with
Western Europe. Meaning, in response to
preparations against a real invasion
from Putin targeting territory clearly
belonging to the Baltic states, Putin
threatens to use nuclear weapons. So
how should one understand this? First,
we need to add that the use of nuclear
weapons remains a final resort. Because
even the use of tactical nuclear
weapons would paint a target on the
foreheads of not only Putin but also
many in his inner circle. Given that in
such a case, every measure would be
used to eliminate these individuals, it
is clear that, as in the case of Osama
Bin Laden, the consequences would fall
upon their relatives, families, and so
on. Everyone around Putin understands
that, and so no one wants this to
happen. I think Putin himself does not
want that, and he is aware of this.
Thus, it is very likely just another
rhetorical attack intended to confuse
Westerners so they pressure their
governments. Because they feel afraid.
Attacking NATO using conventional
warfare methods is a huge risk for
Putin. We can see that currently the
Russian army cannot even cope with the
war in Ukraine. A country with a
population 5 to 7 times smaller than
Russia and also inferior in other
metrics. Meanwhile, if he attacks NATO,
Putin would have to decide to go to war
with an alliance five to seven times
larger than Russia. I think he has no
doubt about the consequences of such an
attack. But as always, there are a few
nuances to keep in mind. This time, as
usual, the issue lies in perceptions.
If he gets the feeling that Western
countries are not ready to act as a
united front, that he could strike a
certain nation and the rest would not
intervene, then based on that feeling,
he might try to carry out such a
provocation to break the Western
alliance. This issue has already been
discussed in quite some detail in
Western nations. But regardless, it
would still be a terrible mistake, an
extremely serious error. Because we see
that in reality, despite the current
pressures, people in Western countries
are becoming more indignant than afraid
. The readiness for a military
confrontation is increasing, not
decreasing. Of course, there is no
shortage of panicky screaming. But
overall, the willingness to engage in a
military confrontation is growing day
by day. And I fear that if Putin’s
mind truly snaps and he decides that he
can risk launching an attack, that
attack would end in a major war. This
major war might not lead to the
destruction of entire human
civilization, but the probability that
we would lose tens of millions of lives
in both Europe and Russia is very high.
However, regardless, everyone is
currently watching what Putin does—
not what he says, but what he is
actually doing. And here are signs
indicating his troop numbers are rising
, meaning he is increasing the size of
his military. As I recall, the current
ceiling for the Russian armed forces
has been raised to 2.2 million people.
Accordingly, a process is underway to
prepare for additional recruitment.
This is exactly the hidden mobilization
we are talking about. It is very likely
that about 300,000 additional people
will be quietly recruited from
different regions. Moreover, a
mobilization decree was issued long ago
, so there is no need to declare it
again. This process will take place
gradually. By the way, some people ask
why the figure is 300,000. That is
because of the capacity of the training
and supplementary facilities Mr. Putin
can provide within one year. Only that
much. That is why we mention the
approximate figure of 300,000, or
perhaps 400,000 people. They will be
crammed in, trained less, and equipped
with worse weapons. But the scale he
can manage is completely understandable
. In addition, everyone is watching
where these people will be concentrated
. If these forces are brought in to
reinforce the front lines in Ukraine,
then clearly the plan is to continue
this aspect of the war. If these people
are concentrated in other locations,
then depending on the location of the
buildup, countermeasures will be taken.
Because anyone can see that. But can it
be said that this will be done in
secret? No. It is impossible to do this
in secret. Because modern methods for
monitoring the movement of such large
forces and equipment ensure 100%
detection. If before the war in Ukraine
began, someone still might have thought
otherwise. The Kremlin explained these
were just exercises, so we did not need
to worry. Then now, it is obvious that
no one can be reassured that way and no
one thinks like that anymore. If they
see a concentration of military forces
at a certain border, other armies will
also be deployed to it. And
unfortunately, this will significantly
increase the risk of military conflict.
In short, as of now, Putin is mainly
just intimidating Europe, but in the
next 6 months, these threats could
begin to turn into reality. Ladies and
gentlemen, we are witnessing a series
of moves that Mr. Putin is launching.
The general mobilization of at least
300,000 to 400,000 more troops is
already clear. Then there is the
nuclear threat, the intensification of
airstrikes on the capital Kyiv, and
attacks on bridges and roads. So, if
this does not resolve the war, what
will be Mr. Putin's next move? I invite
you to help me by leaving your thoughts
in the comments section below. I would
like to thank you and look forward to
seeing you in the next program. Thank
you all very much.
